lines.en: label library30:
scene nodokafirst1
I walk into the library first thing in the morning to be greeted by a rather unusual sight.
lines.zh: 一大早我走进图书馆，迎面撞见一幅相当不寻常的景象。

lines.en: And by unusual I mean a sight I have literally never seen before.
lines.zh: 说它不寻常，是因为这情景我这辈子真的从没见过。

lines.en: Typically, Futaba will spend her mornings rearranging books or...picking up books, or...
lines.zh: 平时，Futaba 的上午都是用来整理书架，或者……把书捡起来，或者……

lines.en: Well, you get the point.
lines.zh: 嗯，你懂的。

lines.en: There are a lot of books involved.
lines.zh: 总之离不开一大堆书。

lines.en: It’s not often she actually engages with anyone other than me.
lines.zh: 她其实很少跟我以外的人打交道。

lines.en: Is this girl planning on stealing Futaba away from me?
lines.zh: 这女孩是打算把 Futaba 从我身边抢走吗？

lines.en: : Who are you and what do you want with my librarian?
lines.zh: : 你是谁？你想对我的图书管理员做什么？

lines.en: : {i}Your{/i} librarian? Futaba didn’t tell me the two of you were in that sort of relationship.
lines.zh: : {i}你的{/i}图书管理员？Futaba 可没告诉我你们俩是那种关系。

lines.en: : Sincerest apologies for what I am about to tell you, but this {i}librarian{/i} has been my property for several years now.
lines.zh: : 对于接下来我要说的话，我深表歉意——这位{i}图书管理员{/i}几年来一直是我的所有物。

lines.en: : I’m willing to share her as long as you go through the proper request process. There are several caveats, however.
lines.zh: : 只要你走正规的申请流程，我愿意把她分你一半。不过有几条注意事项。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst2
: No touching, no teasing, no flirting, no talking, no exchanging of gifts (Including those sexual in nature), no staring and, most importantly-
lines.zh: : 不准碰，不准逗，不准调情，不准说话，不准互赠礼物（包括性性质的），不准盯着看，而最重要的是——

lines.en: scene nodokafirst3
: No-doka.
lines.zh: : No-doka（不行哦）。

lines.en: : I have no idea what that last one even means.
lines.zh: : 最后那条我完全不知道是什么意思。

lines.en: : It’s my name. Nodoka Nagasawa, a friend of Futaba’s from another[school].
lines.zh: : 那是我的名字。Nodoka Nagasawa，Futaba 在另一所[school]的朋友。

lines.en: : I’ve seen her exposed breasts more times than you.
lines.zh: : 她的裸胸，我见的次数可比你多。

lines.en: I wouldn’t be so sure about that...
lines.zh: 这我可不敢打包票……

lines.en: scene nodokafirst4
: Nodoka was in town on a...business trip, I guess?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 是来镇上……出差吧，大概是？

lines.en: : She decided to stop by before heading back to the outer-barrier.
lines.zh: : 她在回外隔离区之前，决定顺道过来看看。

lines.en: : Business trip? How old are you?
lines.zh: : 出差？你多大了？

lines.en: : Old enough. You need not concern yourself in my private ordeals.
lines.zh: : 够大了。我的私人事务你不必操心。

lines.en: : You’re not some sort of prostitute, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是干那行的吧？

lines.en: : Not that I am aware of.
lines.zh: : 据我所知不是。

lines.en: : Are you the type to hire those sorts of people? If so, would you mind if I asked you some questions?
lines.zh: : 你是会雇那种人的类型吗？如果是的话，介意我问你几个问题吗？

lines.en: : It’s for research, I swear.
lines.zh: : 是为了取材，我发誓。

lines.en: : Right. {i}Research{/i}.
lines.zh: : 是啊。{i}取材{/i}。

lines.en: : No, it really is for research, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不，老师，真的是为了取材。

lines.en: : Nodoka is a writer and tends to dive into rather...unsightly topics at times.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 是个作家，而且时常会一头扎进相当……不堪入目的题材里。

lines.en: : My favorite is [incest]. It’s truly fascinating in fictional settings. Wouldn’t you agree?
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢的是 [incest]。在虚构设定里真是迷人。你同意吧？

lines.en: : Futaba is literally in the same class as my [niece]. I’m not going to share my opinion of [incest] with you. Fictional or not.
lines.zh: : Futaba 可是跟我[niece]同班。我不会跟你分享我对 [incest] 的看法。管它是不是虚构。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst5
: Your lack of a response is the only response I need! Thank you very much!
lines.zh: : 你的沉默就是我需要的答案！非常感谢！

lines.en: What a strange character...
lines.zh: 真是个古怪的角色……

lines.en: : Anyway, were you planning on hanging out with your friend today, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，Futaba，你今天打算和你朋友一起待着吗？

lines.en: : If so, I can just leave you two to it and go figure something else out.
lines.zh: : 如果是的话，我就把你们俩留在这儿，自己去想点别的。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst4
: No need. I need to be heading out anyway.
lines.zh: : 不用。我本来也该走了。

lines.en: : I just wanted to drop by and see if Futaba’s grown anymore since the last time I saw her several weeks ago.
lines.zh: : 我只是想顺道看看，距几周前上次见面之后，Futaba 又长大了没有。

lines.en: : She refused to take her shirt off in the library, though, so I don’t think I’ll be getting an answer today.
lines.zh: : 不过她不肯在图书馆里把上衣脱掉，所以我看今天是得不到答案了。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst6
: You never change, do you?
lines.zh: : 你一点都没变呢。

lines.en: : Why would I? I’m perfect the way I am. Just like you’re perfect the way you are.
lines.zh: : 为什么要变？我现在这样就很完美。就像你现在这样也很完美。

lines.en: : Well, thanks Nodoka. I’m glad to hear-
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢谢你，Nodoka。我很高兴听——

lines.en: : Let’s get married.
lines.zh: : 我们结婚吧。

lines.en: : Damn it. You’ll agree to that one day.
lines.zh: : 可恶。总有一天你会答应的。

lines.en: : I really won’t...
lines.zh: : 我真的不会……

lines.en: scene nodokafirst7
: You there. Glasses-companion. Let me know if you can figure out Futaba's latest cup-size.
lines.zh: : 那边那个。眼镜同伴。要是你能查出 Futaba 最新的罩杯，记得告诉我。

lines.en: : Is that for research as well?
lines.zh: : 那也是为了取材吗？

lines.en: : No. It’s for my own personal records.
lines.zh: : 不。是留作我个人记录。

lines.en: : I see. That’s good enough for me. I’ll have Futaba send you a message once I find out.
lines.zh: : 明白了。这个理由对我足够了。等我查到了，会让 Futaba 给你发消息。

lines.en: : Why are you agreeing to this? And why do I have to be the one to send the message?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会答应啊？还有为什么要我来发消息？

lines.en: : Because I don’t give my number to strangers.
lines.zh: : 因为我不把号码给陌生人。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst8
: But anyway, thanks for letting me visit for a little bit.
lines.zh: : 总之，谢谢你让我来待了一会儿。

lines.en: : This library is much smaller than the one I’m used to, but it’s cute. It’s got a sort of...rustic charm to it.
lines.zh: : 这家图书馆比我常去的那家小多了，不过很可爱。有种……质朴的韵味。

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll come back one day?
lines.zh: : 也许哪天我还会再来？

lines.en: scene nodokafirst9
: Sayonara, Futaba! And you as well, mystery-man!
lines.zh: : 再见啦，Futaba！还有你也是，神秘男！

lines.en: : My name is Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我的名字是老师。

lines.en: : No it isn’t!
lines.zh: : 才不是呢！

lines.en: Nodoka exits the library and leaves Futaba and I sitting there in silence for a little while.
lines.zh: Nodoka 走出了图书馆，留下 Futaba 和我在那里沉默地坐了一会儿。

lines.en: : So anyway, that’s Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 总之，那就是 Nodoka。

lines.en: : She seems...fun.
lines.zh: : 她看起来……挺有意思。

lines.en: : She’s a lot.
lines.zh: : 她这个人信息量很大。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst10
: She’s one of the smartest people I know, though. You should read some of her work if you ever get the chance.
lines.zh: : 不过她是我认识的人里最聪明的之一。有机会的话，你该读读她的作品。

lines.en: : Where would I find it? Is she online or something?
lines.zh: : 上哪儿能找到？她有在网上发表之类的吗？

lines.en: : I can...umm...maybe send you a few links?
lines.zh: : 我可以……呃……也许发几个链接给你？

lines.en: : Do you have my number? Or email address or anything?
lines.zh: : 你有我的号码吗？或者邮箱地址什么的？

lines.en: scene nodokafirst11
: Well, no...But if you wanted to maybe...give it to me or something...that would be okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯，没有……不过如果你愿意……把它给我什么的……那也可以。

lines.en: : That’s not too weird to say, right?
lines.zh: : 这么说应该不算太奇怪吧？

lines.en: : I promise I’d only text you if I need something or...have to give you something.
lines.zh: : 我保证只在我有事找你、或者……得给你什么东西的时候才发短信。

lines.en: : You can text me whenever you want. I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 你想什么时候发都行。我不在意。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst12
: Really?! You mean it?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！你说真的？！

lines.en: scene nodokafirst13
: Oh! Umm. Sorry. I didn’t expect to react that way.
lines.zh: : 啊！呃。对不起。我没想到自己会反应这么大。

lines.en: : I don’t know what came over me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己是怎么了。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没关系。别放在心上。

lines.en: I take my phone and slide it across the table, giving Futaba the go-ahead to enter her contact info.
lines.zh: 我掏出手机从桌上推过去，示意 Futaba 可以把她的联系方式输进去。

lines.en: She nervously does so and, before long, both of our phones are back in our respective pockets.
lines.zh: 她紧张地照做了，没过多久，我们俩的手机就各自回到了各自的口袋里。

lines.en: $ futabanumber = True
{i}Congratulations! You now have Futaba’s phone number!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你现在拥有 Futaba 的电话号码了！{/i}

lines.en: : So, now that your friend is gone and the two of us are alone, there’s been something I’ve been meaning to ask you.
lines.zh: : 那么，既然你朋友走了、只剩我们俩，有件事我一直想问你。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst14
: Umm...it’s nothing...you know...{i}sexual{/i}, is it?
lines.zh: : 呃……该不会是……你知道的……{i}那方面{/i}的事吧？

lines.en: : I’ve accepted that we have that type of relationship now but I still don’t know if I’m comfortable...you know, {i}helping{/i} you out in the library.
lines.zh: : 我已经接受我们现在是那种关系了，但我还是不确定自己能不能……你知道的，在图书馆里{i}帮{/i}你解决。

lines.en: : There are people around and-
lines.zh: : 毕竟周围还有人，而且——

lines.en: : I was actually just going to ask if everything was okay.
lines.zh: : 其实我只是想问你，一切都还好吗。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst15
: Huh?
: What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that we haven’t really talked about what randomly sent you home from the beach.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我们还没好好聊过，到底是什么让你突然从海滩提前回了家。

lines.en: : Molly was pretty upset that you weren’t able to play that game with everyone, and that seemed like something you’d be really into.
lines.zh: : Molly 因为你没能和大家一起玩那个游戏挺失落的，而且那看起来是你肯定会喜欢的事。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst16
: On second thought, maybe I could...give you a handjob...under the table or something...
lines.zh: : 再想想，也许我可以……在桌子底下给你打个手枪什么的……

lines.en: : As much as I love under-the-table handjobs, it sounds to me like you’re trying to hide something.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很喜欢桌子底下的手枪，但我听着觉得你是在试图隐瞒什么。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst17
: That doesn’t sound very confident, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来可没什么底气，Futaba。

lines.en: : Why would you even want to know that? I look fine now, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非要知道那个？我现在看起来不是好好的吗？

lines.en: I hadn’t noticed before, but now that I’m paying closer attention, Futaba does look a little bit...off.
lines.zh: 我之前没注意到，但现在仔细一看，Futaba 确实看起来有点……不太对劲。

lines.en: I can’t really pinpoint exactly what’s wrong, but something’s different.
lines.zh: 我说不清到底是哪里不对，但确实有什么不一样了。

lines.en: And no, I’m not talking about her hair being down. It’s something more than that.
lines.zh: 不，我说的不是她把头发放下来了。是比那更深层的东西。

lines.en: : I want to know because I care about you.
lines.zh: : 我想知道，是因为我在乎你。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst18
: S-Sensei...You can’t just come out and say that all of a sudden...it’s embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 老、老师……你不能就这么突然说出来……太难为情了。

lines.en: : There are people around. Someone might hear you.
lines.zh: : 周围还有人呢。说不定会被谁听到。

lines.en: : What’s so bad about people hearing that I care for one of my students? I care about all of you.
lines.zh: : 被人听到我关心自己的学生，有什么不好的？你们所有人我都关心。

lines.en: : It’s just...someone might get the wrong idea.
lines.zh: : 只是……别人可能会误会。

lines.en: : Well that’s on them, then. But don’t worry about other people right now.
lines.zh: : 那就是他们的问题了。不过现在别管别人。

lines.en: : If something is bugging you, it’s okay to tell me.
lines.zh: : 如果有什么事困扰着你，跟我说也没关系。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst19
: Th-thanks...but I’m pretty sure I’d rather keep this thing to myself if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 谢、谢谢……不过我大概还是想自己留着这件事，可以吗？

lines.en: : It’s not like...a really big deal or anything. It would only create more problems for you.
lines.zh: : 这又不是什么……大不了的事。说出来只会给你添更多麻烦。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst20
: But I’ll be better for it in the long run. Just worry about yourself and let me deal with my issues on my own.
lines.zh: : 但长远来看，这样对我更好。你操心好自己就行了，我的问题让我自己处理。

lines.en: : ...It’s not about Yumi, is it?
lines.zh: : ……不是 Yumi 的事吧？

lines.en: : It’s not. She actually hasn’t even said anything to me since the beach.
lines.zh: : 不是。其实从海滩那次之后，她连一句话都没跟我说过。

lines.en: Huh...if Yumi’s not the source of her problems this time, I wonder what is?
lines.zh: 嗯……如果这次 Yumi 不是问题的根源，那会是什么呢？

lines.en: I know her family lives overseas so...maybe it’s something that has to do with them?
lines.zh: 我知道她家人住在国外，所以……也许跟他们有关？

lines.en: Either way, it doesn’t look like she’s willing to reveal whatever’s going on right now, so I should probably just talk about something else.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，她现在看起来不打算说出发生了什么，所以大概还是聊点别的吧。

lines.en: : So, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 话说，Nodoka。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst21
: Yes, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Nodoka。

lines.en: : She’s cute, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她很可爱吧？

lines.en: : If there’s anything I’ve learned about girls that I’m {i}involved{/i} with it’s to never talk about how cute other girls are around them.
lines.zh: : 要说我在跟我有{i}牵扯{/i}的女孩身上学到了什么，那就是千万别在她们面前说别的女孩有多可爱。

lines.en: : I don’t see a problem with you thinking she’s cute. {i}I{/i} think she’s cute and I’m not planning on leaving you for her.
lines.zh: : 你觉得她可爱，我倒不觉得有什么问题。{i}我{/i}也觉得她可爱，但我没打算为了她离开你。

lines.en: : Though, I think she'd be quite happy if I did.
lines.zh: : 不过，我要是真那么做了，她大概会相当高兴。

lines.en: : If you do decide to do that, please let me know in advance so I can buy a video camera.
lines.zh: : 如果你真打算那么做，请提前告诉我，好让我去买台摄像机。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst22
: Please stay out of my first lesbian relationship. You and I are no longer together.
lines.zh: : 请你别插手我的第一段女同恋情。你和我早就结束了。

lines.en: : What we had was fun, but it was as fleeting as a summer breeze.
lines.zh: : 我们曾经的那段很快乐，但它就像夏日的微风一样转瞬即逝。

lines.en: : You were just an old tooth that happened to be pushed out by a new one.
lines.zh: : 你只是一颗旧牙，恰好被新牙顶掉了而已。

lines.en: : That first metaphor was a little stronger than the tooth one.
lines.zh: : 第一个比喻比牙齿那个要好一点。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst23
: We can’t all be Nodokas, you know? I’m doing my best.
lines.zh: : 我们又不可能人人都像 Nodoka，对吧？我已经在尽力了。

lines.en: : That’s right. You are doing your best. And that’s really all that matters.
lines.zh: : 没错。你确实在尽力。而这才是真正重要的。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst15
: Hm? Why are you getting serious all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你怎么突然认真起来了？

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to. It just kind of slipped out, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我不是有意的。大概只是不小心说漏嘴了吧。

lines.en: : Maybe I’m subconsciously worried about you since you’re keeping your first ever secret from me.
lines.zh: : 也许我是下意识地在担心你，毕竟你正对我保守着有史以来第一个秘密。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst10
: Who said this is the first?
lines.zh: : 谁说这是第一个了？

lines.en: : Either way, I think you should {i}subconsciously{/i} stop because it’s harder for me to smile when you’re not smiling.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我觉得你还是{i}下意识地{/i}别担心了，因为你不笑的时候，我也很难笑出来。

lines.en: : And yes, I know that line probably needed some work as well.
lines.zh: : 还有，我知道这句话大概也需要再打磨一下。

lines.en: : It was better than the tooth one at least. That one still hits me the wrong way for some reason.
lines.zh: : 至少比牙齿那个好。不知为什么，那句到现在还是让我觉得别扭。

lines.en: : Yes, yes. I know it was bad. I won’t talk about teeth anymore.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我知道那句很糟。我不会再提牙齿了。

lines.en: : I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 感激不尽。

lines.en: I pull my phone out of my pocket and check the time to find that it’s getting close to lunch.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里掏出手机看了看时间，发现已经快到午饭时候了。

lines.en: Since the two of us don’t seem to have anything else going on, maybe Futaba will want to come out for a little bit?
lines.zh: 既然我们俩看起来都没别的事，也许 Futaba 愿意出去待一会儿？

lines.en: No harm in asking, I guess.
lines.zh: 问问也无妨吧。

lines.en: : Hey, are you doing anything after this?
lines.zh: : 嘿，等一下你有什么安排吗？

lines.en: scene nodokafirst15
: Like, after the library? Not really. Why?
lines.zh: : 你是说，从图书馆出去之后？没什么啊。怎么了？

lines.en: : Did you want to come get lunch or something? I’m probably going to head out soon.
lines.zh: : 要不要一起去吃个午饭什么的？我大概快要走了。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst21
: That does sound fun, but I need to stay here for pretty much the entire day today.
lines.zh: : 听起来是挺好玩的，不过今天我基本得在这儿待一整天。

lines.en: : Thank you for inviting me, though. It makes me happy to hear that...you want to spend more time with me and stuff...
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你邀请我。听到……你想多花点时间陪我什么的，我很开心……

lines.en: : You have to spend the whole day here? Aren’t you a volunteer?
lines.zh: : 你得在这儿待一整天？你不是志愿者吗？

lines.en: : I am, but that doesn’t mean I can just leave whenever I want.
lines.zh: : 是志愿者，可这不代表我想走就能走。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst24
: I have a responsibility and I can’t walk away from it. That’s what it means to be an adult.
lines.zh: : 我有一份责任，不能一走了之。这就是身为大人的意义。

lines.en: : But of course you wouldn’t know that since you’ve given up on teaching and just want to hang out with everybody instead.
lines.zh: : 不过你当然不懂了，毕竟你已经放弃了教书，只想跟所有人混在一起。

lines.en: : Don’t question my methods. Your grades are better than ever.
lines.zh: : 别质疑我的方法。你们的成绩比以往都好。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst25
: Grades? We have grades?
lines.zh: : 成绩？我们有成绩这回事吗？

lines.en: : I thought we were just messing around.
lines.zh: : 我还以为我们只是在闹着玩呢。

lines.en: : We were, but I’m giving you an F now for losing faith in my patented system.
lines.zh: : 本来是，但你现在对我的专利体系失去信心，我要给你打个 F。

lines.en: scene nodokafirst13
: An F?! You can’t do that! I thought we were just joking!
lines.zh: : F？！你不能这样！我还以为我们只是在开玩笑！

lines.en: scene black
Little does Futaba know, I’m the most serious man in the world.
lines.zh: Futaba 不知道的是，我是全世界最严肃的男人。

lines.en: I never joke about anything.
lines.zh: 我从来不开玩笑。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: But either way, I’m significantly less willing to spend my entire day wasting away in a library than Futaba is.
lines.zh: 不过不管怎样，我可比 Futaba 更不愿意把一整天都耗在图书馆里虚度。

lines.en: Who cares about responsibility when there are more important, more fulfilling things to be doing?
lines.zh: 既然还有更重要、更能让人满足的事可做，谁还在乎什么责任？

lines.en: I offer to buy Futaba something and bring it over in order to make her double-volunteer-shift a bit more bearable, but she shrugs off my act of generosity and tells me she brought something with her.
lines.zh: 我提出给 Futaba 买点什么送过来，好让她连着两班志愿者的时光好熬一点，但她对我这份慷慨不以为意，说自己带了东西。

lines.en: What a bitch.
lines.zh: 真是个混蛋。

lines.en: Just kidding again.
lines.zh: 又开玩笑的。

lines.en: Not knowing what else to do, I stop at a nearby burger joint and grab a quick lunch before getting on with my day...
lines.zh: 不知道还能干什么，我在附近一家汉堡店停下，匆匆吃了顿午饭，然后继续我的一天……

lines.en: $ library30 = True
$ futaba_love += 1
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
